item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 19 September 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 19 September 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) 🚩 The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation and liberated Maryevka and Gulevo (Donetsk People's Republic). 💥 Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one special forces brigade, and two national guard brigades have been hit near Belozerskoye, Druzhkovka, Artema, Varvarovka, Starorayskoye and Novoyavlenka (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 410 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, three self-propelled artillery systems, and 11 motor vehicles. 🚩 The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depths of the enemy's defence and liberated Zelenaya Dibrova (Zaporozhye region). 💥 Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades and two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Manvelovka, Malinovka, Kolomiytsy (Dnepropetrovsk region), Petropavlovskoye, and Obshcheye (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ The AFU lost up to 280 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 10 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun. 📍 The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. Formations of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, and Dimitrovo (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ More than 55 troops, 18 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations were neutralised. ✈

🚩
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation and liberated Maryevka and Gulevo (Donetsk People's Republic).
💥
Manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one special forces brigade, and two national guard brigades
have been hit
near Belozerskoye, Druzhkovka, Artema, Varvarovka, Starorayskoye and Novoyavlenka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 410 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, three self-propelled artillery systems, and 11 motor vehicles.
🚩
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depths of the enemy's defence and liberated Zelenaya Dibrova (Zaporozhye region).
💥
Strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades and two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Manvelovka, Malinovka, Kolomiytsy (Dnepropetrovsk region), Petropavlovskoye, and Obshcheye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU lost up to 280 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 10 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, and Dimitrovo (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 55 troops, 18 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
ammunition, fuel, and military hardware depots, assembly workshops as well as storage facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles and their components, transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formation and foreign mercenaries in 142 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
seven guided aerial bombs, one U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectile, and 936 fixed-wing UAVs.
📊

item.title: ⚡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ⚡️ The Sever Group's units in the north-eastern part of Kharkov region tighten the encirclement ring and expand the external control area. 💥 The neutralisation of the encircled enemy units continues close to Grachovka, Krasny Yar, and Khripuny (Kharkov region). 🚩 In the course of decisive actions, the settlements of Loshakovo and Komissarovo (Kharkov region) have been brought under control, and combat actions to liberate Buzovo (Kharkov region) are carried out. ▪️ Over the past 24 hours, up to 30 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and two motor vehicles have been neutralised. ↗️ During the external control area expansion, the AFU's formations are being neutralised near Petropavlovka, Novoaleksandrovka, and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region). 🔥 In addition, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade close to Korbiny Ivany, Chernoglazovka, Bratenitsa, Podsredneye, and Velikiy Burluk. 💥 In Sumy region, clusters of manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit close to Khoten, Rudnevka, and Pushkarevka (Sumy region). ▪️ In total, over the past 24 hours, the enemy lost up to 245 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces. 📍 The Zapad
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29503

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
The Sever Group's units in the north-eastern part of Kharkov region
tighten the encirclement ring and expand the external control area.
💥
The neutralisation of the encircled enemy units continues
close to Grachovka, Krasny Yar, and Khripuny (Kharkov region).
🚩
In the course of decisive actions, the settlements of Loshakovo and Komissarovo (Kharkov region) have been brought under control, and combat actions to liberate Buzovo (Kharkov region) are carried out.
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, up to 30 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and two motor vehicles have been neutralised.
↗️
During the external control area expansion,
the AFU's formations
are being neutralised
near Petropavlovka, Novoaleksandrovka, and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
🔥
In addition, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade close to Korbiny Ivany, Chernoglazovka, Bratenitsa, Podsredneye, and Velikiy Burluk.
💥
In Sumy region,
clusters of manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
have been hit
close to Khoten, Rudnevka, and Pushkarevka (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, over the past 24 hours, the enemy lost up to 245 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of three mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Bazaliyevka, Berezovka, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), and Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 210 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, including two U.S.-made M113 armoured personnel carriers, 12 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade, and one mountain assault brigade near Vysokoivanovka, Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, and Shabelkovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 145 troops, 19 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29498

▫️
Increasing the rate of advance in all directions
📊
Since the beginning of this year, more than 5,300 square kilometres of the territory and more than 220 settlements have been liberated. Moreover,
in September, more than 670 square kilometres and 27 settlements were brought under Russian control.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces
successfully continues to create a security belt in the border areas of Sumy and Kharkov regions.
💥
The destruction of AFU units, surrounded in the north-eastern part of Kharkov region, continues. Since 5 September, the territory controlled by the enemy has been reduced by 152 square kilometres. The Russian control was established over nine settlements (Berezniki, Ozernoye, Dolgenkoye, Zarubinka, Chernyakov, Shirokoye, Shevchenkovo, Olkhovatka, and Malaya Volchya). The enemy lost up around 700 troops.
↗️
The offensive in Zaporozhye region is actively developing. The formations and military units of
the Vostok and Dnepr Groups are advancing on a wide front towards Zaporozhye.
Since the beginning of September, they have liberated Chervonaya Krinitsa, Novopavlovka, Novoandreyevka, and Rozovka. Combats are carried out in the central quarters of the city of Orekhov.
💥
The most intensive combat operations are conducted on the approaches to Kramatorsk-Slavyansk Agglomeration.
The formations and military units of
the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces and Tsentr Group of Forces
cross the enemy's fortified lines of defence on the closest approaches to Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, and Druzhkovka. Street combats are underway in the central area of Doborpolye.
👉
Against the background of the high pace of Russian troops' advance in all directions,
the Kiev authorities are once again trying to convince their Western supervisors of the AFU's ability to resist Russian army
in the area of responsibility of the Zapad Group of Forces. To demonstrate this,
the AFU command brought to the combat the most trained units and nationalist formations
of the 3rd Separate Assault Brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
▫️
At the same time, with the help of Western media and military experts,
the Kiev regime is conducting an aggressive information campaign
trying to pretend the actions of the Armed Forces of Ukraine successful on the battlefield and intercepting the initiative from the Russian troops.
❗️
In fact,
small assault groups of the enemy, suffering significant losses and attempting to break through Russian combat formations close to the line of contact, falls flat.
The Zapad Group's units thwart the AFU's raids, inflict fire damage on the enemy, and prevent his further actions.
🚩
Moreover,
the Group's units are conducting successful combat operations to liberate the settlements of Chervony Oskol, Crymki, and Studenok.
In Krasny Liman and Svyatogorsk, the clean-up of residential quarters from single servicemen of the Armed Forces of Ukraine continues.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched UAV strikes against Ukrainian logistics centres and ports, vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched UAV strikes against Ukrainian logistics centres and ports, vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, as well as transport infrastructure facilities. The following targets were engaged: 📍 in Kiev region: ▫️ the Kopylov Logistik Park customs and logistics centre in the settlement of Kopylov (6 km west of Kiev) used for storing and distributing military cargo arriving in Ukraine from European countries. 📍 in Odessa region: ▫️ a pontoon bridge on the Dniester river used for the transit of military cargo delivered to Ukraine from Romania and the port of Izmail; ▫️ a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo in the port of Chernomorsk. 💥 In addition, two dry cargo ships delivering military supplies intended for the support of the AFU were hit on their way to the port of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
